fomod.Name: Wintersun Nordic Addon
fomod.Author: WhisperDealer
fomod.Description: Extends Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim with the Nordic pantheon: Kyne, Jhunal, Stuhn, Tsun, Orkey, the Nordic aspects of Mara and Dibella, and Alduin - each with tenets, a blessing, boons, devotee effects and shrine map markers. Requires Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim.
